This is a very fun and interesting game. The reason I am giving it a negative review is that it has one big problem that I cannot overlook. 

Obey is a multiplayer-only game. You can jump right in to playing using the public servers, or by setting up a LAN party. If you want a private lobby though, you have to make one yourself. By "make one yourself" I don't mean just pressing the host button and inviting your friends over the Steam multiplayer interface. What I mean is buying a Raspberry Pi, starting up a VM, downloading the server exe, giving your friends your IP address so they can join, then solving all of the networking errors that ensue. Also, we looked for a Docker image to make this a little easier, there is none.

If, at any point, the devs made hosting a private lobby just a matter of clicking the host button and sending a Steam invite, I would change this review right away.
